GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 2nd last Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, tailed off from turn, Tongue Tie first time, winkers first time # tailed off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and slipped on jumping. Over-raced during the early and middle stages. Near the 1000m, was obliged to ease when awkwardly placed close heels. Near the 400m, was bumped by a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out . Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide No Cover early . Worked to hold ground until in Two Wide @ 600m & struggling to hold ground Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Five Wide in straight. # Worked & tired.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and checked when tightened between runners shortly after. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Bumped shortly after straightening.
Blundered on jumping. Shortly thereafter, bumped with a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , carried Four Wide at 750m, Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, steered wider rounding turn but losing ground at the same time, couldn't come on in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re racing four-wide from barrier 2. App. jockey stated she was mindful of its history of pulling, she shifted 3-wide when it began to pull early and she was carried 4-wide at the 800m.] # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest re racing wide from barrier 2 app stated mount has a history of pulling & she was mindful of this leading into event. App stated in early stages mount commenced to pull & she elected to shift it 3 wide, without cover, so as to allow it clear running rather than attempt to hold it in behind other runners. App stated near 800m the runner to her inside shifted out resulting her mount being obliged to race 4 wide, without cover, from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Raced keenly 3rd 3 Wide No Cover before over-raced & worked to lead on inside @ 1000m. Over-raced & worked 3L clear @ 800m & headed @ 500m. Weakened from home turn. # Over-raced/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, Lost Ground rounding turn and in Straight # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 5th 5 Lengths 600m 6th 3 Wide 5 Lengths home turn 5th Middle Of Track Straight weakened final 200m # wide/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 300m, shifted in and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace until improving slowly from 550m. Pushed out Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & gave ground in last 200m. # Worked & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 1 length settling down, Held Together in front & led 1 length rail turning, steered 3-4 Wide Straightening Up , got wider inside the 200m then laid out befopre being corrected, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure between the 200m and 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went back to 2nd last 8len 3wide Hooked Out 600m Straight green but only fair # av effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Hampered and carried wider approaching the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME) # no excuses
